corrections.why: Both Brown Creek pages say only the 1960s for destruction; neither gives 1960.

notes_for_editor: Location conflict is unresolved: the FFLA list gives 46.32278, -115.82422 (the record's point); the brief also cites 46.31556, -115.80472 from Idaho Fire Lookouts, but the fetched Idaho page has no coordinates, so that second position could not be checked; the story gives only the FFLA position. 'Browns Creek Lookout' appears in The Clearwater Story (npshistory.com, chapter 3; undated visit, a woman lookout from Weippe who had worked since the war) and in TPA annual-report quotes on the weebly Brown's Creek #1 page. The sources do not say which Browns Creek tower is meant, so those mentions are left out. Brown's Creek #1 is a different tower (1910 crow's nest, 1934 100-foot steel tower, torn down 1999) and must not be merged. The 1913 log cabin is listed on the same entry; no source says whether it stood on the same spot as the 1934 tower. No staffing history is documented (Idaho Fire Lookouts). Destruction is known only to the decade.
